description: IMPORTANT: Always prefer to use get_design_context. Get metadata for a node or page in XML format: node IDs, layer types, names, positions and sizes, useful for an overview of the structure. nodeId can be a page id (e.g. 0:1). When nodeId is omitted, returns the pages of the document (and saved snapshots) instead. When something is selected in Figma, the response starts with a "Currently selected nodes:" block.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

name: get_metadata
title: Get Metadata
